title: Readout from Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent's Meeting with Mexican Secretary of Finance Edgar Amador Zamora
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Mexican Secretary of Finance Edgar Amador Zamora on April 14, 2026 to continue discussions on the U.S.-Mexico Action Plan on Critical Minerals and the USMCA review process. The Secretary also encouraged continued cooperation on combating drug trafficking and shared illicit finance priorities.
key_points: Secretary Bessent and Secretary Zamora continued discussions on the U.S.-Mexico Action Plan on Critical Minerals
The two officials engaged further on the outlook for the USMCA review process
Secretary Bessent encouraged Mexico to continue working closely with Treasury on combating drug trafficking and shared illicit finance priorities
The meeting took place on April 14, 2026 in Washington D.C.
